summary: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 3.5 Live Translate, a new audio model providing near real-time speech-to-speech translation in 70+ languages, rolling out via the Gemini Live API, Google Meet, and the Google Translate app.

practices.reason: The model offers continuous, low-latency speech-to-speech translation across 70+ languages with noise robustness, giving teams building multilingual audio products a concretely better capability to adopt.
practices.quote: The model automatically detects 70+ languages and generates smooth, natural-sounding translated speech that preserves the speakers' intonation, pacing and pitch.

practices.reason: A new API surface and third-party SDK integrations (Agora, LiveKit, Pipecat, etc.) mean engineering teams building voice apps have a new interface to evaluate and wire in.
practices.quote: By utilizing the Gemini Live API, developer platforms like Agora , Fishjam , LiveKit , Pipecat , and Vision Agents enable developers to build and deploy voice translation apps with ease.

practices.reason: The disclosed SynthID watermarking on generated audio is a content-provenance technique engineers could note for their own trust and safety pipelines, though it is described only as the lab's internal process.
practices.quote: All audio generated by our models is watermarked with SynthID. This imperceptible watermark is woven directly into the audio output, ensuring AI-generated content remains detectable to help prevent misinformation.
